    Atom Builder

    Drag protons and neutrons into the nucleus. Drag electrons onto the shells. Watch the element card: the number of protons decides the element! 10 per round. Fewer hints and fewer misses = more points. Fill the shells from the inside out to earn a bonus shell star.

    Atom 1/10

    Drag particles in, or tap a bin. Tap a particle to take it out. Keys: P N E (Shift + key takes one out).

    Balance the scale. Atoms can't be lost or made, only rearranged!

    Atom Diner

    Customers order molecules. Smash the ingredients into atoms, then rebuild them into the dishes. Every atom has to end up on a plate. Atoms are never lost and never made, only rearranged!

    ⌨️ Shortcuts: number keys add atoms, Space smashes the next ingredient, Backspace clears the plate.

    Separation Station

    Mixtures are piling up at the factory! Put machines on the conveyor belt to split each mixture into pure substances. Spend as little as you can to earn 3 stars.

    1. Pick a level below.
    2. Drag machines from the list onto the belt (or click a machine, then click a spot).
    3. Press Run and watch the factory work. Each goal substance must end up pure, alone in its own bin.

    Laser Maze MS-PS4-2

    Light up every crystal with the laser! Mirrors reflect light, glass lets it through, and black material soaks it up. Use as few pieces as you can to earn 3 stars.

    1. Pick a level below.
    2. Drag a piece into the maze (or click a piece, then click a square). Click a placed mirror to flip it.
    3. Light every crystal and keep the beam off the alarms. The beam updates as you build.

    Blackout! MS-PS3-6

    The city has gone dark! Wire batteries, bulbs and switches so electric current carries energy to every lamp. Use as few pieces as you can to earn 3 stars.

    1. Pick a level below.
    2. Drag along the dashed lines with the Wire tool to build the circuit. Click a switch to open or close it. Click a battery to flip it.
    3. Press Test the city. Every test must pass: lights on, and lights still on when a bulb burns out!

      Evidence Lab MS-PS1-2 · PS1-7

      Mystery samples need a detective! Run tests, read the evidence and name each sample. Then decide whether a change was a chemical reaction. Fewer tests earns a higher rank.

      1. Pick a level below.
      2. Drag a tool onto the sample and watch what happens. Compare it with the field guide.
      3. Name the sample. A wrong guess costs 2 tests!

      Level 1/15
      Tests 0
      3 uses 0 or fewer

      Drag a tool onto the bench. Or tap a tool, then tap the bench. Keyboard: Enter picks up, Enter drops.

      Coaster Architect MS-PS3-1 · PS3-2

      Design a roller coaster that really works! Set the heights, then launch the cart and watch potential energy turn into kinetic energy and heat. Use the lowest lift hill that works to earn 3 stars.

      1. Pick a level below.
      2. Drag track pieces from the toolbox into the dashed slots, and steel onto the track. Drag the blue handles to set the heights.
      3. Press Launch. The dashed line shows the energy the cart has left.

          Founder panel

          Teacher Panel

          Every student's scores are saved online. They show up here as soon as a round ends.

          Speed columns show best average time. Atom shows the best score for levels 1 / 2 / 3. Diner shows best coins for Breakfast / Lunch / Dinner. Sep ★ is total stars across all Separation Station levels.

          Progress

          Everything about your students' progress in one place: a curve for every game, Pre-Test and Post-Test growth, and the elements they miss most. Every round is saved automatically.

          Only your own students are shown here. No other teacher can see them, and you cannot see anyone else's.

          Students

          Counts come from Speed Find and Element Trivia: each time a student clicks the wrong element or misses the answer, that element gets one more miss. Use the top ones for a quick reteach or a warm-up.
